changes.title: ‘Cockroaches won’: India’s youth protest leaders declare victory as minister resigns
changes.summary: India’s viral Cockroach Janta Party called off its nationwide protests on Saturday after the country’s education minister resigned and the government agreed to a number of the activist movement’s demands.
